errors.planUnresolved: We couldn't verify your plan. Reload the page to try again.

page.title: Passes (TotalPass · Wellhub)
page.subtitle: Connect your location so TotalPass members can book and check in to your classes from their app (Wellhub, coming soon). You decide how many spots they get.
page.info: TotalPass pays you for every confirmed visit (Wellhub, coming soon). Here you connect your location, link your classes and decide how many spots to offer.
page.readOnly: Read only: to connect or change settings, ask a business administrator.

teaser.title: What this does
teaser.bullet1: TotalPass members see your classes in their app and book on their own (Wellhub, coming soon).
teaser.bullet2: When they arrive, their check-in is confirmed and the provider pays you for that visit.
teaser.bullet3: You decide how many spots per class go to passes, with suggestions based on how your classes fill up.

wellhub.title: Wellhub
wellhub.description: Formerly Gympass. You'll be able to connect it as soon as Wellhub hands us your location's credentials.

totalpass.title: TotalPass
totalpass.description: TotalPass members book and check in to your classes from their app.
totalpass.planPaused: Your plan no longer includes passes. We no longer publish new classes on TotalPass; what was already published or booked is honored and its check-ins are still confirmed.
totalpass.pausedHint: This connection is paused. Paste your key to reconnect it.
totalpass.pendingHint: The last attempt to connect didn't finish. Paste your key again.
totalpass.revokedHint: TotalPass rejected the key for “{{place}}”. Paste a new key to reconnect, or disconnect to clean up the connection.
totalpass.keyHint: Get it in the TotalPass Partner Portal → Integrations → Create new code. Paste it as is; we strip the spaces.
totalpass.rekeyHint: Use it if you added or changed plans in TotalPass.

mode.label: How attendance gets confirmed
mode.autoHint: Each check-in is confirmed on its own as soon as the member checks in: nobody has to mark it.
mode.onCheckinHint: Confirmed when the front desk, the kiosk or the coach marks the member as arrived. If nobody does it in time, TotalPass won't pay for that visit.

totalpass.disconnectBody: Your classes will stop being published on TotalPass and members won't be able to book. To reconnect you'll need to paste your key again.
totalpass.disconnectNoKey: Since the connection isn't active, Avoqado can't remove your classes from TotalPass. If any are still published there, delete them from the TotalPass Partner Portal.

products.title: Classes offered to TotalPass
products.description: Pick the TotalPass plan for each class. Classes left as “Not linked” aren't published.
products.missingPlan: Plan that no longer exists in TotalPass
products.noPlans: Your TotalPass location has no plans yet. Create them in their portal and reconnect.
products.noClasses: You have no “Class” products. Create one in the menu to link it.
products.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} classes. If you need to link the rest, write to us.

capacity.title: Spots for passes
capacity.description: How many spots per class go to TotalPass and Wellhub members. Both share the same cap; the most specific rule wins: class > day and time > general.
capacity.loadError: Couldn't load the spots for passes

default.label: In every class, up to
default.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 500, or leave it empty.

weekly.title: Exceptions by day and time
weekly.empty: No exceptions: the general cap applies to every class.
weekly.deleteBody: Those classes go back to the general cap.

dialog.title: New exception
dialog.subtitle: For one weekday (and a time, if you want), how many spots go to passes.
dialog.spotsHint: From 0 to 500. 0 = those classes aren't offered to passes.

errors.time: Enter the class time or check “All day”.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Based on how your classes fill up with your own clients over the last 8 weeks.
suggestions.line: Your {{day}} {{time}} classes fill up to {{pct}}% with your own clients → we suggest {{spots}}
suggestions.empty: Not enough data yet (3 weeks of classes are needed).
